BL-652 — done_with_current.sh silently ignores every argument and completes anyway: a usage probe (--help) archives the whole in-process batch
What it solves: QA e2e procedure: in a scratch role mailbox with a two-item in_process
batch, run `done_with_current.sh --help` — expect non-zero exit, usage
text, both items still in in_process, no completed batch dir, and no
ready_for_next output; then run `done_with_current.sh` with no arguments
and confirm the…
Approval context: Filed from an accepted hardener rule_proposal (2026-07-25): a "--help" probe archived both in-process batch items, including a not-yet-worked BL-633 handoff, before merge/implement/forward — only the git-based forward saved the ticket. The prompt-rule mitigation is already landed in hardender.promp…
